messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected from model-serving runtime in us-west-2. Observed spike in segfaults/OOMs across pool `runner-gpu-pool-A`. Summary: 5xx rate up from 0.2% -> 7.8% over the past 7m. Suggested playbook: `runtime-oom-segfault`.
Priya Patel: paging oncall @Miguel - I see traces showing repeated SIGSEGV from `model-runner` process. Customers seeing timeouts and gateway 502/504.
Miguel Torres: oncall here. joining. can someone paste the top logs? I’m pulling runbook now.
Ava Cheng: logged: 
```
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z runner[pid=4210] ERROR: kernel: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f... sp 0x7fff... code=1
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z runtime: process 4210 killed by signal 11
2026-03-15T10:12:04Z evictor: node gpu-11: OOM during kvcache alloc 2.1GB
```
Jamal Reed: console shows memory thrash leading into OOM, then segfaults. It's hitting a new large-context model rollout we did earlier today (model v3.2b-qual).
Miguel Torres: confirming. Traffic routing shows 60% of requests to that model variant. I'm going to drain the pool `runner-gpu-pool-A` to stop new allocations and failover to pooled fallback.
Priya Patel: please coordinate with runtime team – @Ava can you open `incident/xxxx` page and add customers impacted? I see 2 enterprise tenants with high error rates.
Ava Cheng: opened incident page: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-03-15-4391012345. Adding initial impact notes and a link to canary dashboard.
runtime-bot: ACTION: Initiating drain on `runner-gpu-pool-A` (cmd: `infra drain-pool --pool runner-gpu-pool-A --reason "segfault/OOM spike"`). Estimated drain time: 90s.
Miguel Torres: running quick diagnostic: `kubectl logs runner-4210 -n inference | tail -n 200` shows repeated allocation failures from `kv_cache::allocate_prefetch()`.
Ava Cheng: also seeing `cudaMalloc` failures on nodes: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in GPU driver logs.
Jamal Reed: quick mitigation plan: 1) Drain pool A, 2) Reroute traffic to fallback lighter model v3.2b-quant or v3.1, 3) Force disable large-context option for that model, 4) Roll restart model-runner on remaining hosts to clear corrupted state.
Priya Patel: Miguel, can you perform the reroute? We need to reduce customer-facing 5xx asap. Marking priority P0.
Miguel Torres: reroute in progress: `router set-weight --model v3.2b-qual 0.0 --model v3.2b-quant 0.7 --model v3.1 0.3 --reason "emergency fallback"`.
incident-bot: NOTE: Routing change executed by miguel.t at 10:18:12Z. Telemetry will reflect new weights in ~30s.
Ava Cheng: after reroute status: error rate dropping from 7.8% -> 2.4% within 2 minutes. Timeouts reduced but still some 5xx from ongoing restarts.
Miguel Torres: draining finished; pool `runner-gpu-pool-A` drained to 0 active pods. Doing rolling restart on `model-runner` pods in other pools to clear potential corrupted KV cache state.
Jamal Reed: command: 
```
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=model-runner -o name); do kubectl delete $pod -n inference --grace-period=30; sleep 6; done
```
Priya Patel: flagged customers: AcmeCorp, Finlytics — both reported increases in observed latency and 5xx. @customer-success will follow up. Adding to incident page.
runtime-bot: HOTPATCH: A temporary guard added to runner binary to fail fast on `kvcache` prefetch > 1.5GB to avoid OOM. Patch id: rhd-hotpatch-20260315-1.
Ava Cheng: logs after hotpatch: `kvcache` now returning ENOMEM earlier, requests falling back to CPU path instead of crashing. Observed fewer segfault stack traces.
Miguel Torres: monitoring shows 5xx rate stabilizing at 0.8% now. Latency back to normal 95th pct. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
Priya Patel: good. tagging infra and eng-runtime to start root cause analysis. @Jamal please capture heap profiles from affected nodes and upload to incident page.
Jamal Reed: uploaded heap dumps and core files to incident page. note: cores show corrupted pointer in `kvcache::insert()` path.
Ava Cheng: adding rollback plan: if errors reappear, rollback model v3.2b-qual completely and pin to v3.1 for the next 24h.
Miguel Torres: executing post-mitigation steps: 1) keep v3.2b-qual weight at 0, 2) schedule full cluster drain and replace for pool A, 3) prepare hotfix candidate for runtime.
incident-bot: UPDATE: Customers impacted: AcmeCorp (errors peaked 18%), Finlytics (errors peaked 9%), internal-prod tests. Incident severity: SEV2 -> investigating for SEV1 if customers report outages.
Priya Patel: we need a customer-facing note draft. Quick: "We've observed elevated errors due to runtime memory issues for a model variant. We've rerouted traffic and applied a temporary mitigation. We're investigating and will update within 60 minutes." Anyone refine?
Ava Cheng: suggest adding: "No data breach. Root cause appears to be runtime memory handling with large context allocations. We will notify if we expect sustained degradation."
Miguel Torres: agreed. I'll send from CS channel once we validate stability for 10m.
Jamal Reed: follow-ups: repro on staging with same model and context size failed with same OOM -> will add test to CI that simulates large-context streaming allocations.
Priya Patel: timeline note: initial alert 10:12Z, reroute 10:18Z, hotpatch applied 10:23Z, drain complete 10:19Z, effective error rate <1% by 10:26Z. Marking next update at 10:50Z.
runtime-bot: REMINDER: create postmortem ticket and assign to eng-runtime, eng-ml, and infra within 24h: `pm create --title "model-runner-kvcache-oom-segfault-20260315"`
Miguel Torres: thanks team. I'll stay on for monitoring. If anything spikes, ping me. Closing live mitigation thread once stable for 30m.
Priya Patel: acknowledged. I'll coordinate CS updates and schedule bridge for postmortem.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: Mitigated (monitoring)."
